t: For an additional amount for “Salaries and expenses” for carrying out titles VI, VII, and VIII of the Health Services and Centers Amendments of 1978 and title XIII of the Public Health Service Act, $11,000,000, including $1,500,000 for section 1317 of the Public Health Service Act: Provided, That funds for carrying out sections 1303(i) and 1304(k) of the Public Health Service Act which are unobligated on September 30, 1979 shall be available through September 30, 1980.

fable.w: This is a pure appropriations provision supplying additional funds and extending the availability of unobligated funds. It establishes no comment period, hearing, advisory body, consultation with outside parties, or right to sue; the tempting reading that the referenced health programs involve outside entities fails because the section itself only funds them and creates no participatory process.
fable.s: For an additional amount for “Salaries and expenses” for carrying out titles VI, VII, and VIII of the Health Services and Centers Amendments of 1978 and title XIII of the Public Health Service Act, $11,000,000

opus.w: This is an appropriations provision. It sets the amount of money for salaries and expenses and extends the period when unobligated funds can be used. It sets up no process, such as consultation, a hearing, a comment period, an advisory body or a right to sue, through which outsiders take part in a federal decision. Cross-references to programs elsewhere in the statute do not themselves create participation.
opus.b: 1. **Tempting reading:** The section cites programs under the Public Health Service Act and the Health Services and Centers Amendments of 1978. Some of those programs may involve outside entities, such as health maintenance organizations (HMOs) under title XIII. **Why it fails:** This text only appropriates money and extends how long certain funds stay available. It does not set up any consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body, rulemaking authority or right to sue that would bring outsiders into a federal decision.

qwen_chat.w: This section is an appropriations provision that authorizes funds for salaries and expenses. It does not establish any mechanism for public participation, consultation with outside entities, or advisory committees. The mere mention of carrying out other titles does not constitute participation in this specific section.
qwen_chat.s: For an additional amount for “Salaries and expenses” for carrying out titles VI, VII, and VIII of the Health Services and Centers Amendments of 1978 and title XIII of the Public Health Service Act, $11,000,000
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that "carrying out" titles of an act implies some form of public engagement or consultation required by those titles. However, this section is purely an appropriations clause authorizing funds. It does not describe any specific process of consultation, hearing, or advisory committee involvement within the text itself. It merely allocates money.
